inlines.text: OpenAI 第三季度营收大幅增长，主要靠新 AI 模型和企业客户拉动。但经营亏损仍在扩大，而竞争对手 Anthropic 在 IPO 前的运营效率要高得多。

blocks.text: 据 华尔街日报 和 The Information 报道，OpenAI 第三季度营收环比增长约 50%，达到 100 亿美元。第二季度的营收增幅仅为 17% 到 18%。一年前，该公司的营收为 39 亿美元。

blocks.text: 尽管一年内营收增长了两倍，调整后经营亏损 还是在第三季度从 101 亿美元小幅升至 109 亿美元。这一数字不包括股权激励费用，该项费用已攀升至 26 亿美元。调整后经营利润率确实有所改善，从第二季度的负 150% 升至负 109%。一年前为负 97%。

blocks.text: 这让 OpenAI 落后于行业领头羊 Anthropic，后者计划于下周 IPO。这家 Claude 开发商已在第二季度营收上超过 OpenAI，当时甚至还实现了小幅经营利润。第三季度，Anthropic 营收增长 47%，达到 170 亿美元，而包括股权激励费用在内的经营亏损仅为 5.67 亿美元。

blocks.text: 效率差距归根结底在于商业模式。Anthropic 高度聚焦企业客户，以及 Claude Code 和 Claude Cowork 智能体等成功工具。相比之下，OpenAI 为机器人等广泛研究提供资金，还经营着一项成本高昂的消费者业务。

blocks.text: 为了在企业市场迎头赶上，OpenAI 今年早些时候调整了优先级。公司砍掉了视频应用等项目，把更多资源投入 编程工具 Codex，并聘请 Dali Rajic 担任新的销售负责人。与此同时，OpenAI 下调了新模型的价格。

blocks.text: OpenAI posts a massive Q3 revenue jump, driven by new AI models and enterprise customers. But operating losses keep growing, while rival Anthropic operates far more efficiently ahead of its IPO.

inlines.text: OpenAI posts a massive Q3 revenue jump, driven by new AI models and enterprise customers. But operating losses keep growing, while rival Anthropic operates far more efficiently ahead of its IPO.

blocks.text: According to reports from the Wall Street Journal and The Information, OpenAI grew its revenue by about 50 percent quarter over quarter in Q3 to $10 billion. In Q2, revenue had grown by just 17 to 18 percent. A year earlier, the company brought in $3.9 billion.

inlines.text: According to reports from the
Wall Street Journal
and
The Information
, OpenAI grew its revenue by about 50 percent quarter over quarter in Q3 to $10 billion. In Q2, revenue had grown by just
17 to 18 percent
. A year earlier, the company brought in $3.9 billion.

blocks.text: Despite tripling revenue within a year, adjusted operating losses rose slightly in Q3 from $10.1 billion to $10.9 billion. That figure doesn't include stock-based compensation, which climbed to $2.6 billion. The adjusted operating margin did improve, going from negative 150 percent in Q2 to negative 109 percent. A year earlier it was negative 97 percent.

blocks.text: That puts OpenAI behind industry leader Anthropic, which plans its IPO next week. The Claude developer already overtook OpenAI on revenue in Q2 and even posted a small operating profit at the time. In Q3, Anthropic grew revenue 47 percent to $17 billion, while its operating loss including stock compensation came to just $567 million.

blocks.text: OpenAI cuts prices and chases enterprise customers with new revenue streams

inlines.text: OpenAI cuts prices and chases enterprise customers with new revenue streams

blocks.text: The efficiency gap comes down to business models. Anthropic focuses heavily on enterprise customers and successful tools like Claude Code and the Claude Cowork agent. OpenAI, by contrast, funds broad research into robotics and runs an expensive consumer business.

inlines.text: The efficiency gap comes down to business models. Anthropic focuses heavily on enterprise customers and successful tools like Claude Code and the Claude Cowork agent. OpenAI, by contrast, funds broad research into robotics and runs an expensive consumer business.

blocks.text: To catch up in the enterprise market, OpenAI reshuffled its priorities earlier this year. The company discontinued projects like a video app, put more resources into its coding tool Codex, and hired Dali Rajic as its new head of sales. At the same time, OpenAI cut prices on new models.

blocks.text: Third-party data showed companies seeking cheaper alternatives to Claude, which boosted API sales. OpenAI president Greg Brockman called it an incredible revenue turning point and pointed to major customers like JPMorgan Chase. The enterprise business doubled in Q3 and now accounts for the bulk of revenue, Brockman said.

blocks.text: The consumer side is growing too. ChatGPT now has 1.2 billion weekly active users, with 100 million paying subscribers after 22 million new sign-ups. On top of that, the new ChatGPT ad product hit an annualized revenue run rate of $1 billion in August.

blocks.text: Both competitors are feeling the recent tech sell-off in the financial markets. OpenAI is targeting an IPO next year and is currently raising fresh capital at a $1.25 trillion valuation, but has so far raised less than half of the planned $30 billion. Anthropic also had to cut its IPO valuation target significantly.
